name: Ethan MacLeod
title: Junior Network Engineer
summary: Junior Network Engineer with hands-on experience supporting LAN/WAN environments, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and assisting with network monitoring and documentation. Brings a strong foundation in Cisco networking, VLANs, VPNs, and switching/routing concepts, with a detail-oriented approach to maintaining reliable and secure infrastructure.

bullets: Supported a 600+ user corporate network across two office locations and a hybrid remote environment.
Resolved an average of 25-30 Tier 2 network incidents per month, reducing repeat tickets by 18% through improved documentation.
Assisted with switch configuration, VLAN changes, and access port troubleshooting during planned maintenance windows.
Monitored alerts in SolarWinds and escalated critical issues, helping maintain 99.8% network uptime.
Provided daily support for LAN, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity across 12 client sites in the Greater Toronto Area.
Performed basic firewall rule validation and port testing, contributing to faster resolution of connectivity incidents.
Maintained network diagrams, asset records, and change logs for over 450 devices.
Supported office moves and equipment refreshes, including deployment of switches, wireless access points, and patch panels.
Delivered frontline technical support for students and staff in a 3,000-user campus environment.
Assisted with network jack testing, printer connectivity, and account access issues, closing 40+ tickets weekly during peak periods.
Helped deploy and label network equipment in labs and classrooms, improving asset tracking accuracy by 22%.
Escalated complex routing, DNS, and authentication issues to senior engineers with clear troubleshooting notes.
Shadowed network operations staff and assisted with cable testing, rack organization, and equipment inventory.
Documented maintenance activities and helped update IP address spreadsheets for internal teams.
Supported after-hours change windows by verifying device status and confirming service restoration.
Gained exposure to MPLS, VoIP, and basic firewall operations in a service-provider environment.

education.degree: Bachelor of Information Technology, Network Systems
education.institution: University of Ontario Institute of Technology
